description: This file is a PHP source file that provides a library for SOAP web services using the NuSOAP toolkit. It includes classes for SOAP message construction, fault handling, XML schema parsing, and HTTP transport mechanisms. The file defines core classes such as nusoap_base, soap_fault, XMLSchema, soapval, and soap_transport_http, which collectively facilitate creating, parsing, and transmitting SOAP messages.

classes.name: nusoap_base
classes.description: Base class providing utility methods for SOAP message handling, serialization, and debugging.

classes.name: soap_fault
classes.description: Class representing a SOAP fault message for error reporting in web services.

classes.name: XMLSchema
classes.description: Class for parsing and representing an XML Schema definition used in SOAP message validation.

classes.name: soapval
classes.description: Class representing a serializable SOAP value with associated XML element/attribute metadata.

classes.name: soap_transport_http
classes.description: Class handling HTTP/HTTPS transport for sending and receiving SOAP messages.

classes.name: soap_server
classes.description: Class allowing creation of a SOAP server capable of receiving messages and returning responses.

classes.name: wsdl
classes.description: Class representing and parsing a WSDL file, providing access to its data and utility functions for SOAP service generation.

methods.name: serialize_val
methods.description: Method to serialize PHP values into SOAP XML format, considering types and attributes.

methods.name: serializeEnvelope
methods.description: Method to serialize the entire SOAP envelope, including headers and body.

methods.name: addComplexType
methods.description: Method to define and add a complex type schema to the XMLSchema object.

methods.name: addSimpleType
methods.description: Method to add a simpleType schema definition.

methods.name: addElement
methods.description: Method to add an element definition to the schema.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a SOAP operation with specific input/output parameters, namespace, style, use, documentation, and encoding style.

methods.name: fault
methods.description: Specifies a SOAP fault to be returned to the client, acting as an error response.

methods.name: configureWSDL
methods.description: Sets up the WSDL definition including service name, namespace, endpoint, style, transport, and schema namespace.

methods.name: parseWSDL
methods.description: Parses a WSDL file from URL or file path, building internal representations of services, messages, port types, bindings, and schemas.

methods.name: start_element
methods.description: Handles the start of an XML element during WSDL parsing, managing different schema, message, portType, binding, and service elements.

methods.name: end_element
methods.description: Handles the end of an XML element during WSDL parsing, finalizing schemas and other components.

methods.name: character_data
methods.description: Handles character data read during WSDL parsing, accumulating contents for elements like documentation or message parts.

methods.name: serializeRPCParameters
methods.description: Serializes PHP values into SOAP XML format for a specific RPC operation, considering the WSDL message definitions.

methods.name: serializeType
methods.description: Serializes a PHP value into XML according to type definitions derived from XML Schema and WSDL.

methods.name: serializeComplexTypeAttributes
methods.description: Serializes attributes for complexType elements based on schema definitions and PHP values.

methods.name: serializeComplexTypeElements
methods.description: Serializes child elements for complexType elements based on schema definitions and PHP values.
